description: Release comparison: cff9b08 baseline, outgoing ACK retry, bounded source materialization, and rejected spurious-recovery undo v0. No concurrent builds or loads. Each phase uses fresh daemons and ascending 15-second points plus 2-second drain. Requested bridge rates exceed the generator's measured offered rate. Undo v0 has a subsequently found cross-episode correctness bug and is not production code.
